package network

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

func TestIndependentReadWriteAndSameDirectionRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(42)
	read, _, releaseRead, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead)
	if !ok || read != 42 {
		t.Fatal("read owner")
	}
	write, _, releaseWrite, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite)
	if !ok || write != 42 {
		t.Fatal("independent write owner")
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead); ok {
		t.Fatal("duplicate read queued or admitted")
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite); ok {
		t.Fatal("duplicate write queued or admitted")
	}
	releaseRead()
	_, _, releaseNext, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("retired direction not reusable")
	}
	releaseNext()
	releaseWrite()
}

func TestCloseCancelsBothDirectionsButWaitsForRealAcknowledgements(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(42)
	_, readContext, releaseRead, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("read owner")
	}
	_, writeContext, releaseWrite, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("write owner")
	}
	closed := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		value, first := owner.beginClose()
		if !first {
			closed <- -1
			return
		}
		closed <- value
	}()
	<-readContext.Done()
	<-writeContext.Done()
	select {
	case <-closed:
		t.Fatal("close consumed live borrows")
	default:
	}
	releaseRead()
	select {
	case <-closed:
		t.Fatal("close refunded unacknowledged write")
	default:
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamReady); ok {
		t.Fatal("borrow after closing")
	}
	releaseWrite()
	if <-closed != 42 {
		t.Fatal("original owner lost")
	}
	owner.finishClose()
	if _, first := owner.beginClose(); first {
		t.Fatal("duplicate final own handle")
	}
}

func TestSendShutdownSharesWriteOwnerAndPreservesRead(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(7)
	_, readContext, releaseRead, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("read owner")
	}
	_, _, releaseShutdown, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("send shutdown prevented by independent read")
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite); ok {
		t.Fatal("write overlapped send shutdown")
	}
	select {
	case <-readContext.Done():
		t.Fatal("send shutdown cancelled independent read")
	default:
	}
	releaseShutdown()
	if owner.active != 1<<streamRead {
		t.Fatal("pending read owner refunded by shutdown")
	}
	releaseRead()
}

func TestCloseWithoutBorrowRetainsOneFinalOwner(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(91)
	value, first := owner.beginClose()
	if !first || value != 91 {
		t.Fatal("initial own value")
	}
	owner.finishClose()
	if owner.value != 0 {
		t.Fatal("value retained after actual final close")
	}
	if _, first := owner.beginClose(); first {
		t.Fatal("second own value")
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamInspect); ok {
		t.Fatal("closed inspect admitted")
	}
}

func TestInvalidOwnerDirectionOrContextNeverBorrows(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(1)
	var absent *connectionOwner[int]
	if _, _, _, ok := absent.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead); ok {
		t.Fatal("nil owner")
	}
	if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(nil, streamRead); ok {
		t.Fatal("nil context")
	}
	for _, direction := range []int{-1, streamDirections, 100} {
		if _, _, _, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), direction); ok {
			t.Fatal("invalid direction")
		}
	}
	if owner.active != 0 {
		t.Fatal("invalid input changed owners")
	}
}

func TestDuplicateReleaseFailsClosedWithoutRefundingAnotherDirection(t *testing.T) {
	owner := newConnectionOwner(1)
	_, _, release, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamRead)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("read owner")
	}
	_, _, releaseWrite, ok := owner.borrow(context.Background(), streamWrite)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("write owner")
	}
	release()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Fatal("duplicate release accepted")
			}
		}()
		release()
	}()
	if owner.active != 1<<streamWrite {
		t.Fatal("unrelated write owner refunded")
	}
	releaseWrite()
}
